CAUTION: CHEMICAL PAINT STRIPPERS WILL ATTACK RESIN SYSTEMS, AND SHOULD NOT BE USED TO REMOVE PAINT BEFORE MAKING DAMAGE ASSESSMENT. (1) Examine visually for extent of damage. (2) Check panel in vicinity of damage for entry of water, oil, fuel, dirt, or other foreign matter. (3) Check for delamination around the damage by tapping firmly on the skin with a small solid metal disk. Tap uniformly, following parallel lines along the suspect area. If delamination is present, a dull sound will be heard as opposed to a clear metallic ring on a solidly bonded area. With the aid of a marker, the contour of the delaminated area may be determined by marking the spots where the changes in sound occur (figure 603).
